purpose: Preserve official interaction evidence for the G1 acquisition means test without promoting canonical endpoints or interpreting compatibility.

acquisition.extraction: inert HTML extraction with opt-in provisional text-claim preservation
acquisition.interpretation_boundary: Claims below are source-backed observations, not compatibility or installed-relationship conclusions.

source_locator.section: Everything you need and want to know

claims.source_wording: Keep track of all important battery information on your smartphone, in real-time. Metrics include state of charge, time remaining, voltage, current, amp hours, number of charge cycles, and deepest discharge.

The SmartShunt shares battery voltage, current, and temperature with connected chargers to enhance charging efficiency and extend battery life. Connect wirelessly via VE.Smart Networking or plug it into a communication centre (optional).
claims.scope: SmartShunt product-family page; connected chargers; optional communication centre

claims.source_wording: The VE.Direct port connects to a communication centre for access to VRM, Victron's remote management portal. Configure settings, check system data, analyse performance, and actively manage your system from anywhere in the world.
claims.scope: SmartShunt product-family page; communication centre and VRM

claims.source_wording: These are mostly connected via BMS-Can (CANBus) on a GX device.
claims.scope: Victron ecosystem guidance; lithium and other chemistries when communication is required

source_locator.section: Common issues we have seen from other DIY / Self-build oriented BMSes

claims.source_wording: Victron requires the BMS to change the Charge Voltage Limit (CVL) to restrict the power flowing to the battery.
claims.scope: Victron guidance for a BMS-controlled lithium integration

claims.source_wording: The GX-device lies at the heart of the system - providing monitoring, and operating as the communication-centre of your installation. All the other system-components - such as inverter/chargers, solar chargers, and batteries - are connected to it.
claims.scope: GX product family; not an exact SKU claim

claims.source_wording: Make sure the Venus GX is running v2.06 or later.

A BMS-Can port is a port dedicated to only be used for connecting managed batteries ... To connect such managed battery, use our VE.Can to CAN-bus BMS cable ... The baudrate of a BMS-Can port is fixed to 500kbps.
claims.scope: GX hardware variants and managed-battery integration; exact hardware revision matters

claims.source_wording: Use this cable to connect a CAN-bus enabled battery, not from Victron, to a Victron system. There are two types, A and B. See the manual for details on which cable to use for which brand of batteries.
claims.scope: Cross-manufacturer battery to Victron system; cable type depends on battery brand

claims.source_wording: Yes - compatible with Epoch Li-Ion app for iOS and Android
claims.scope: Exact product B24100A-C and Epoch Li-Ion app

claims.source_wording: Overcharge, over-discharge, over-current, short circuit, high and low temperature disconnects

negative_findings: No official source in this set proves Epoch B24100A-C interoperability with Victron GX, MultiPlus, or BMS-Can.
No source proves that a SmartShunt measurement is available to a particular non-Victron endpoint.
Protection/disconnect wording does not prove externally observable protection state.
Manufacturer identity or shared ecosystem membership does not by itself prove compatibility.
The source extractor previously emitted zero facts for paragraph-only interaction claims; the opt-in text-claim path now preserves them as provisional unmapped facts.
